_about: Iron per 100g for the tracked products in the iron-rich blog post. Every value is copied from the New Zealand Food Composition Database record named in `recordId` (component FE, mg/100g) — none is estimated. Deep links to single records return 404 on foodcomposition.co.nz, so `url` is the database's search page (look the record ID up there) and `dataUrl` is the same record from the database's own API. `edibleShare` is used only where the reference food is drained but our serve is a fraction of the can's net weight; it is the legume percentage declared in the tracked product's own ingredient list. `reference` holds foods the post discusses that we do not price; same database, same rules. `measure` is the serving weight printed on that database record (e.g. 1 cup of baby spinach = 40g) — used instead of guessing what a cup or a tablespoon weighs.
source: New Zealand Food Composition Database (FOODfiles), The New Zealand Institute for Plant and Food Research Limited and the Ministry of Health

Beef Mince.matched: Beef, mince, prime, 5–10% fat, raw, composite
Beef Mince.note: Tracked product is 10% fat, the boundary between the database's prime (5–10%, 2.1mg) and standard (10–20%, M1233, 2.0mg) composites; prime used. Raw value, because the price and serve are raw weight.

excluded.Egg: Serve is '1ea', not grams; the database's egg serve is a size 6 and the tracked product is size 7 — no weight to multiply by without estimating one.
excluded.Chicken Thigh: Tracked product has no nutrition panel and does not say whether the thighs are skin-on or bone-in, so the serve weight cannot be matched to a flesh-only record.
excluded.Bread: Tracked loaf is a kibbled-grain sandwich loaf (Molenberg Original), not the wholemeal bread the post discusses; no matching database record.
excluded.Canned Tuna: Flavoured (lemon & pepper); the plain spring-water key 'Tuna' is used instead.
excluded.Wholegrain Crackers: Tracked product is brown rice multigrain crackers; no matching database record.
excluded.Weet-Bix: Not a tracked product — no price.
excluded.Pumpkin seeds: Not a tracked product — no price.
excluded.Up&Go: Removed from the fortified-products table: the database record (C1094, assorted flavours) lists no iron fortification and gives 0.36mg/100g — about 0.96mg per 250mL.
excluded.Vogel's bread: Removed: no Vogel's (non-gluten-free) loaf in the database, and 'some varieties' cannot be matched to a record.
excluded.Woolworths wholemeal bread: Removed from the fortified table: wholemeal bread is not iron-fortified; the generic wholemeal record (A1163) is used in the text instead.
excluded.Pams cornflakes: No Pams record; replaced with Sanitarium Skippy Cornflakes (D1057), whose record states Fe fortification.
excluded.Wholegrain crackers (Idea 5): No record matches a generic wholegrain cracker; the post points to the pack's nutrition panel instead of a figure.
